description:
Grand Touring In Aluminum Excellence.
Color: Fog | Molten

Equipped with Bosch e-assist

With a whisper quiet motor capable of 75Nm of torque, this system is wickedly fun. Go from the “all-day ride” Eco mode to an exhilarating Turbo mode with a few clicks of a button on your Smart LED Remote.

The Bosch Smart System ushers in the digital eBike future by fully connecting the eBike Flow app with all eBike components. This allows for over-the-air updates and continuous new functions, like navigation and enhanced theft protection, keeping your eBike current and your riding experience personalized.

Take off and go the distance in our most comfortable trike yet. The GTS (Gran Tourismo Sport) perfectly meshes comfort with performance, giving riders a sporting experience.

A solid 7000 series aluminum frame creates a lightweight ride which dampens vibration, adding to your comfort. The frame also features a rear triangle design, made to make every pedal stroke as efficient as possible. A new larger boom also enhances stiffness, giving a solid-feeling ride.

Precision control is at your fingertips with hydraulic brakes, while trail-commanding deep profile rims and Schwalbe Tryker tires push you forward.

Ride for hours in the new Sport Touring seat, constructed from a light breathable mesh to keep you cool and comfortable. The seat also features an adjustable mid-back section for personalized comfort. The seat is attached using the new Wishbone seat stay design, built to improve stability and handling.

The Battery Network – Bosch Battery Fee
Please note: a $15 recycling fee will be added to the price of every Bosch product with the new Smart System. This program provides support for battery recycling to riders like you! Learn more about the initiative here: batterynetwork.org
